fields.label: Enable Embedding
fields.help: Master toggle for the embedding step. Disable to skip embedding during test runs.

fields.label: Embed Model
fields.help: Hugging Face model ID or local directory name for the embedding model. Resolved relative to DATASET_ROOT.

fields.label: Adapter Path
fields.help: Relative path to a LoRA/PEFT adapter directory. Leave empty if the model already has fine-tuned weights baked in.

fields.label: Embed Log Level
fields.help: Logging verbosity for the embedding step.

fields.label: Compute Precision
fields.help: Model parameter and math precision during forward pass on GPU. Lower precision (fp16/bf16) is faster with negligible retrieval quality impact.

fields.label: Output Precision
fields.help: Dtype used for vectors persisted to disk. pgvector and most tools expect float32.

fields.label: Enable TF32
fields.help: Enable TensorFloat-32 on supported GPUs. Accelerates matmul/convolution on Ampere+ architectures.

fields.label: Embedding Dimension
fields.help: Embedding vector dimension. Must be supported by the model. Higher is better but increases storage.

fields.label: Enforce Embed Dimension
fields.help: When True, the script fails if the model-reported dimension does not match EMBED_VECTOR_DIM.

fields.label: Use Parquet Sidecar
fields.help: Use a lossless Parquet sidecar for embeddings to reduce JSON size and speed I/O.

fields.label: Parquet Filename
fields.help: Output filename for the Parquet sidecar (written next to a_chunks.json).

fields.label: Parquet Compression
fields.help: Lossless compression codec for Parquet. 'zstd' provides a good ratio/speed trade-off.

fields.label: Parquet Row Group Size
fields.help: Number of rows per Parquet row group. Smaller groups improve parallelism; larger groups improve compression. Typical: 4096–65536.

fields.label: Batch Size
fields.help: Texts per GPU batch for SentenceTransformer.encode. Higher is faster; lower it if you hit CUDA out-of-memory.

fields.label: Normalize Embeddings
fields.help: Normalize vectors to unit length (L2) before persistence. Cosine similarity assumes unit vectors.

fields.label: JSON Indent
fields.help: JSON indentation level. 0 or None shrinks file size; 2 is human-friendly.

fields.label: Strip Embeddings in JSON
fields.help: Strip embedding arrays from JSON (set to None) to keep the JSON file lightweight when using Parquet.

fields.label: Provenance Required
fields.help: If the provenance file is missing, fail rather than create a minimal one. Production should be True.

fields.label: Max Embed Chunks
fields.help: For test runs: limit to N chunks. Leave empty (None) to embed all chunks.

fields.label: Chunk Sample Seed
fields.help: Random seed for sampling when CHUNK_SAMPLE_MODE is 'random'. Ensures reproducible subsets.

fields.label: Chunk Sample Mode
fields.help: How to choose the subset when MAX_EMBED_CHUNKS is set. 'head' = first N (stable, fast); 'random' = uniform sample.

fields.label: CUDA Device ID
fields.help: CUDA device index (0-based). Set to None to auto-select the first visible GPU.
